demo.title: pickem.sh
demo.code:
# Show the pick template for an existing contest
bankr prompt "Using the pickem skill, join pickem contest 5"

# Reply with picks (any of these forms work)
bankr prompt "Using the pickem skill, my picks: 1. NE  2. NYG  fill in the rest randomly"

# Check your own picks
bankr prompt "Using the pickem skill, what did I pick in contest 5?"

# Leaderboard
bankr prompt "Using the pickem skill, who's winning contest 5?"

# One-prompt payout
bankr prompt "Using the pickem skill, pay out contest 5"

setup: Install: install the pickem skill from https://superbowlsquares.app/skills/pickem/SKILL.md
Requires the [bankr skill](https://github.com/BankrBot/skills/tree/main/bankr) for wallet operations on Base (chain ID `8453`)
Enable "Arbitrary contract calls" at bankr.bot → Security (one-time, or a timed window) — submitting picks and paying out both call custom Pickem contract functions
Fund the wallet with the contest's entry-fee currency (commonly USDC) plus a small amount of ETH for gas
Source: https://superbowlsquares.app/skills/pickem/SKILL.md (hosted on the app itself, not the BankrBot/skills catalog repo)
